classification.difficultyReason: Compare circles given in different units and with different radius/diameter descriptions.

content.prompt:
Which sushi roll has the larger circumference?
One with a radius 20 mm or one with a diameter 4.5 cm? Justify your answer. Give calculated circumferences to 2 decimal places.

answer.short: The roll with diameter $4.5\text{ cm}$: $141.37\text{ mm}$ compared with $125.66\text{ mm}$.
answer.worked:
For the roll with radius $20\text{ mm}$:
$$\begin{align*}C_1&=2\pi r\\C_1&=2\times\pi\times20\\C_1&\approx125.66\text{ mm}\end{align*}$$
For the roll with diameter $4.5\text{ cm}$:
$$\begin{align*}d&=45\text{ mm}\\C_2&=\pi d\\C_2&=\pi\times45\\C_2&\approx141.37\text{ mm}\end{align*}$$
Since $141.37>125.66$, the roll with diameter $4.5\text{ cm}$ has the larger circumference.
